trades.reasoning: Full multi-signal confirmation (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, and volume surge) justifies deploying part of idle cash even on an otherwise neutral market day.

decisions.briefing: Markets were essentially flat today (NASDAQ -0.3%, S&P 500 -0.0%), a neutral session with no clear risk-on or risk-off signal. We held all 7 existing positions and added META, the only candidate showing the full set of bullish technical signals including a volume surge, while leaving the other 2 open slots unfilled since no other ticker met the same bar of confirmation.

market_education.summary_en: Trading was quiet and directionless today, with the NASDAQ and S&P 500 both essentially unchanged as investors lacked a clear catalyst to push markets meaningfully in either direction. Volume and volatility stayed muted, typical of a consolidation session where traders wait for the next earnings report or economic data point. No major headlines drove today's price action.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市交投淡靜、方向不明，納指及標普500指數均近乎平盤收市，投資者缺乏明確催化劑帶動大市朝任何方向明顯移動。成交量及波幅均偏低，屬於典型的整固行情，市場正等待下一份財報或經濟數據公布。今日並無重大新聞消息主導股價走勢。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Technical confluence means multiple independent indicators — like RSI, MACD, moving averages, and volume — all point the same direction at once, making a signal more reliable than any single indicator alone. Today's META buy is an example: it showed bullish RSI, a MACD crossover, price above its moving average, AND a volume surge together, which is a stronger setup than a stock showing just one of those signals.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 技術指標共振（Technical Confluence）指多個獨立技術指標——例如RSI、MACD、移動平均線及成交量——同時指向同一方向，令訊號比單一指標更可靠。今日買入META便是例子：其RSI偏多、MACD出現黃金交叉、股價高於移動平均線，加上成交量明顯放大，四項訊號同時出現，比只有單一訊號的股票更具說服力。
